assay: bulk poly(A) mRNA-seq, NEBNext Ultra II Directional, NovaSeq 6000 PE100, TopHat/mm10, cufflinks read counts, cuffdiff FPKM with geometric normalization (S4.11.p1-p2)
sample_inclusion: n = 3 animals per group for CON, SS, SES, SER (FIG3 legend; S2.2.p3: 3 mice from each of SES and SER meeting stringent criteria; S4.11.p3: 4 groups x 3 replicates)
sample_exclusion: SR (stress-resilient) mice and SS sedentary-vs-VWR remaining animals were not sequenced (S2.2.p3)
responder_definition: SES/SER assigned post hoc from behaviour (>= 4 favourable of 10 behaviour matrices, k-means) (S2.2.p3, S4.3.p2)
primary_estimand: Effect of 4-week voluntary wheel running on the vHPC transcriptome of stress-susceptible mice, split by behavioural response: SES vs SS (effective exercise response) and SER vs SES (ineffective vs effective); Con vs SS gives the stress signature the exercise is meant to reverse

planned_contrast_labels.grp_SS_vs_CON: Con versus SS (stress effect; not exercise)
planned_contrast_labels.grp_SES_vs_SS: SS versus SES (exercise effect in effective responders)
planned_contrast_labels.grp_SER_vs_SES: SES versus SER (ineffective vs effective responders)

blocking_or_covariance.reason: independent animals, one sample per animal; no batch reported

matrix_scale: FPKM (cuffdiff geometric normalization) used for testing; read counts deposited (S4.11.p2, GEO data_processing)
paper_method: unpaired two-tailed Student's t-test per gene on normalized FPKM (ExDEGA), separate 2-group comparisons

paper_threshold.test: unpaired two-tailed Student's t-test per gene (ExDEGA)
paper_threshold.note: paper wording 'cutoff of 1.3 x fold change (p < 0.05)'; p is strict; whether FC = 1.3 itself counts is not stated - applied as strict (> log2 1.3); no multiple-testing correction

paper_enrichment.ORA: iDEP k-means clustering of DEGs + GO BP (S4.11.p3)
paper_enrichment.GSEA: Broad GSEA, MSigDB M5 (GO), gene-set permutation x1000, FDR < 25% (S4.11.p4)

label_renaming: GEO libraries: C=CON, RS=SS, RES=SES, RER=SER (S4.11.p2)
